message.text:
SSE appears to be the mechanism for pushing live events to browsers.

SSEHub and RegisterSSERoutes appear central to the hub implementation. Memo handlers broadcast through it. The exact hub path and handler names still need to be identified.
I'll look up the live-event mechanism, the hub, and which memo handlers broadcast.

Identifying memo handlers that broadcast live events. So far, CreateMemo and DeleteMemo appear in memo_service.go, and CreateMemoComment appears in memo_service_comments.go.

UpdateMemo and reaction handlers UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction also broadcast. Verifying exact function names and UpdateMemo.

Direct memo handlers broadcast live events: CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction. UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations broadcast indirectly through dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects.

SSE (Server-Sent Events) is the mechanism. The hub is server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. All eight handlers broadcast through it.

q20.
SSE; server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction

The hub is `SSEHub` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`, mounted by `RegisterSSERoutes` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`. Create/Delete/CreateMemoComment broadcast directly in `memo_service.go` / `memo_service_comments.go`. UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations go through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `memo_update_helpers.go`. Reaction handlers broadcast in `reaction_service.go`.
